definition: Exact declared target scope is registered as delivered and verifiable.
deficit_effect: D=0 only for the exact verified target × unit × format; any uncovered curriculum or format remains D=1.
evidence_boundary: Classification uses only existing_local_status and the declared scope in candidate_interventions_master.csv.

definition: At least one exact unit/component is registered, but the declared target scope is incomplete or inconsistent.
deficit_effect: D=0 only on verified covered units/components and D=1 on the residual; no scalar is assigned without a common exact denominator.
evidence_boundary: Classification uses only existing_local_status and the declared scope in candidate_interventions_master.csv.

definition: Research exists, but no delivered target coverage is registered.
deficit_effect: Research without delivered target bytes does not reduce the content deficit; D=1 for the missing comparator.
evidence_boundary: Classification uses only existing_local_status and the declared scope in candidate_interventions_master.csv.

definition: A prior item is registered as dormant and lacks current usable/build evidence.
deficit_effect: A dormant item is not credited without verified usable current bytes and build identity; D=1 pending that registered evidence.
evidence_boundary: No rows in the current 211-row register meet this state; retained as an explicit fail-closed rule.

definition: The same usable target coverage is registered more than once; only a canonical copy may count.
deficit_effect: The canonical item counts once; a duplicate adds no marginal coverage and produces no further reduction in D.
evidence_boundary: No rows in the current 211-row register meet this state; retained as an explicit fail-closed rule.

definition: No exact target coverage is registered in the bounded local census.
deficit_effect: No registered target coverage: D=1 for the declared target × unit × format.
evidence_boundary: Classification uses only existing_local_status and the declared scope in candidate_interventions_master.csv.
